utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Oren — I’m still hoping to get a few helpers this Saturday on the front porch for the repair drive. If you can make it, I’d really appreciate it.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, thanks, Uli — I’d really appreciate the help this Saturday on my front porch. Let me know what time you want me there.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I’m still lining up a few helpers for Saturday’s repair drive on my front porch. If you know anyone handy, please send them my way—I’d really appreciate it.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Sure — what time should I come by on Saturday, and is there anything I should bring?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Yes, I can help out this Saturday. What time should I come by your front porch?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Sam — could you come by around 9:30 so we can get set up before folks arrive? That should give us enough time to sort the tools and keep things moving.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I can help this Saturday on the front porch for the repair drive. I’ll stop by and lend a hand.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That’s wonderful, Vik—thank you. I’ll be on the porch Saturday and I’m grateful for your help.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I’m still looking for a few more helpers for the repair drive this Saturday on my front porch. If you know anyone handy, send them my way.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure, I can help out this Saturday. I’ll ask around too if you still need more hands.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Absolutely — it starts at 10 a.m. on the front porch, and please bring a hammer if you have one.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, that helps — I can be there at 10, and I’ll bring a hammer if I can find one. Do you need me to bring anything else?
